dex.text: Glossy and black, and easily distracted by anything that shines, which is most things. Likes the cold sea wind and a good stone to sit on.
dex.fact: Whitby jet is fossilised wood, and Queen Victoria made it fashionable by wearing it while in mourning.

dex.text: Polished smooth by the tide and very pleased about it. Does not mind being called a stone, though it would much rather be called a jewel.
dex.fact: Whitby jet dates from the Jurassic period, more than 150 million years ago.
